in Arizona to support growing commercial and defense demand</font></div><div style="text-align:center"><font><br></font></div><div style="padding-left:9pt;padding-right:9pt;text-align:center;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="background-color:#ffffff;color:#303030;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">New facility planned for Tempe campus will create approximately 600 jobs, and support current and next-generation aviation technologies and high-priority defense programs</font></div><div style="padding-left:9pt;padding-right:9pt;text-align:center;text-indent:-18pt"><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">PHOENIX, October 28, 2026 &#8211; </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Honeywell Aerospace</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%"> (NASDAQ&#58; HONA) </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">today announced a major expansion of its manufacturing facilities, strengthening the company's ability to meet growing demand across current and next-generation commercial aviation and defense programs.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The new $500 million, 300,000 square foot Tempe, Arizona facility will include an integrated digital production system, modular robotics, automated inspection, digital twins, and be powered by an end-to-end digital thread. This Honeywell Aerospace from-the-ground-up manufacturing facility investment will support the largest commercial and defense customers in aerospace and defense.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#34;Demand for Honeywell Aerospace technologies continues to accelerate across both commercial and defense markets, and this major investment ensures we can continue delivering for our customers while unlocking long-term growth for our shareholders,&#34; said Jim Currier, president and chief executive officer of Honeywell Aerospace. &#8220;This is an example of how our recent spin into an independent, publicly-traded Honeywell Aerospace allows us to make decisions and investments that support our growth and the future of aviation and defense.&#8221;</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The new facility, near the company&#8217;s global headquarters, will create supply chain resilience by adding internal complex machining capability &#8211; a key area of the supply base that is currently constrained &#8211; while establishing a more vertically integrated production system for the next generation of products including Assure advanced actuation systems and Attune vapor cycle cooling subsystems. </font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Opening in late 2028, the advanced manufacturing facility will support customers&#8217; growth on current programs, $15 billion in Control Systems new program wins, and the future of aviation. The expansion will also provide critical capacity growth to support priority production of critical defense technologies included in the supplier framework agreement the company signed with the Department of War in March. </font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The facility will create approximately 600 jobs, increasing the company&#8217;s engineering depth and its skilled workforce.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#34;Arizona has been at the heart of our innovation and manufacturing operations for decades,&#8221; Currier continued. &#8220;Expanding on our existing Tempe campus with this state-of-the-art new facility reinforces our commitment to this great state, our employees and the Arizona workforce, as well as the customers around the world who depend on Honeywell Aerospace technologies every day.&#34;</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div style="height:72pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="margin-bottom:8pt"><font><br></font></div></div></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"><div style="min-height:90.72pt;width:100%"><div><font><br></font></div></div><div style="text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">###</font></div><div style="text-align:center"><font><br></font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font style="background-color:#ffffff;color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:9pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">About Honeywell Aerospace</font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:9pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Honeywell Aerospace (Nasdaq&#58; HONA) is an independent global aerospace and defense company whose critical technologies are broadly deployed on the world&#8217;s leading commercial air transport, business aviation, defense and space platforms. These integrated solutions enable safer, more efficient and more reliable missions. Headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona, the company employs more than 36,000 people globally and supports more than 10,000 customers. With a broad portfolio spanning avionics and navigation systems, engines and power systems, and control systems for aircraft, Honeywell Aerospace combines commitment and deep engineering expertise to drive innovation and long-term value for the aerospace industry. For more information, visit </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:9pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">www.honeywellaerospace.com</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:9pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">  or follow </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:9pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">Honeywell Aerospace</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:9pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%"> on LinkedIn</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:9pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Forward-looking statements</font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:9pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The discussions in the release contain forward-looking statements within the meaning of Section 27A of the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, and Section 21E of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the &#34;Exchange Act&#34;).
